$comment: Single source of truth for the OpenHands gateway tier profiles
(omniroute-tier*.json + litellm-tier*.json): the selectable models.
OmniRoute tiers address combos on :20128 with the openai/ LiteLLM
transport prefix OpenHands requires (without it: provider-not-provided).
LiteLLM tiers address the static fallback on :4000 by its tier
model_names; they ALSO carry the openai/ prefix, which the OpenHands
litellm client stack strips before the HTTP call (measured 2026-09-22:
bare openai/tier2 to the gateway 401s as an unknown provider, while the
proven openai/tier1 profile round-trips - so the wire always carries
the bare tier name the :4000 proxy defines). base_url is
container-side (host.docker.internal); the installer substitutes the
host-side URL nowhere - these profiles only ever run inside the container.
Costs stay 0: billing happens at the gateway, not per profile.
NO KEYS HERE: api_key is injected at install/start time from env
(AUTOOS_OMNIROUTE_KEY for omniroute-*, LITELLM_MASTER_KEY or
AUTOOS_LITELLM_API_KEY for litellm-*) or configuration/api-keys.yml
(omniroute:) / configuration/litellm/.env (master key).
Consumers: lib/**/install.* embedded setup (reads this file, never
inlines tiers), tools/sync-openhands-profiles.py (regenerates user
profiles; run by start-stack on every openhands start), both suites.
